items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think by 1960, Charles, Ornette, Cherry, Hig, all of them, they went to New York.

ctx.x: Los Angeles was an interesting place at that time, but I could never really connect with L.A. It was too – I don’t even know how to describe it, because it was some good people in L.A., but by – I think by 1960, Charles, Ornette, Cherry, Hig, all of them, they went to New York. Garnet Brown was out there too, and he did the same thing. Eventually Garnet, I think, went back to L.A. But it was – and it still is a very strange place, even today. It pretty much – like my grandson said, it is what it is.
I’m thinking, Gerald Wilson’s been out there for a long time.
